construct: Isoniazid is a prodrug activated by mycobacterial KatG catalase-peroxidase. Reactive intermediates inhibit enzymes involved in mycolic acid synthesis, impairing the mycobacterial cell wall.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Isoniazid is activated by mycobacterial KatG. Activated metabolites inhibit mycolic-acid synthesis, disrupting the lipid-rich mycobacterial cell wall.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Ethambutol also affects the mycobacterial cell wall, but it inhibits arabinosyl transferase/arabinogalactan synthesis. Isoniazid's KatG-activated hallmark is mycolic-acid synthesis inhibition.
